random15.instruction: Under the SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 1996, what minimum net worth must an asset management company have to be approved under the eligibility criteria in the general case?

items.source: RBI - Asset Reconstruction Companies – Credit Information Reporting Directions 2025.txt
items.instruction: Under the Reserve Bank of India (Asset Reconstruction Companies – Credit Information Reporting) Directions, 2025, by when must a CI submit the full file of credit information records as on the last day of the month?
items.response: The full file as on the last day of the month must be submitted to the CICs by the 5th day of the next month.

items.instruction: Under SEBI's Infrastructure Investment Trusts Regulations, what is a Self-Sponsored Investment Manager?
items.response: It is the investment manager of an InvIT who has the dual responsibilities of both the investment manager and the sponsor.

items.instruction: What does RBI's Payments Vision 2028 propose for switching transactions on and off across digital payment modes?
items.response: It proposes exploring a similar switch on and switch off facility for all digital payment modes, which would bolster consumer confidence and help control fraud.

items.source: RBI - Trend and Progress of Banking in India Dec 2025.txt
items.instruction: What was the capital to risk-weighted assets ratio of urban co-operative banks in 2024-25 according to RBI's Report on Trend and Progress of Banking in India (December 2025)?
items.response: UCBs remained well capitalised, with CRAR improving to 18.0 per cent from 17.4 per cent a year earlier, mainly on an improvement in the Tier 1 capital ratio.

items.instruction: Under the SEBI ICDR Regulations' listing schedule, what must an issuer do if it fails to apply for listing in time or listing permission is not received?
items.response: The securities are not eligible for listing. The issuer must immediately refund the subscription monies to the allottees, with penal interest at fifteen per cent. per annum for each day of delay from the date of allotment.

items.instruction: Under the RBI (Asset Reconstruction Companies) Directions, 2025, what valuation frequency is required for equity shares acquired by an ARC under a debt-to-equity scheme that is exempt from the 26 percent limit?
items.response: The equity shares must be periodically valued and marked to market, with valuation done at least once in a month.

items.source: RBI - Master Direction on Regulation of Payment Aggregator.txt
items.instruction: What minimum net-worth must an entity seeking PA authorisation hold, and by when must it reach the higher level, under the RBI Master Direction on Regulation of Payment Aggregators?
items.response: It must have a minimum net-worth of ₹15 crore when tendering the application and must attain a minimum net-worth of ₹25 crore by the end of the third financial year of grant of authorisation.

items.instruction: Is biometric data allowed to be stored or collected by digital lending apps under RBI's Digital Lending Guidelines?
items.response: No, unless it is allowed under extant statutory guidelines.

items.instruction: Why was the European Central Bank included in the benchmarking exercise described in the RBI report Benchmarking India's Payment Systems (July 2022)?
items.response: The European Central Bank (ECB) was included only for the indicators on Regulation and Oversight.

items.instruction: How does the glossary of the RBI report Benchmarking India's Payment Systems (July 2022) define Currency in Circulation?
items.response: CIC is the amount of cash within a country that is physically used to conduct transactions between consumers and businesses rather than stored in a bank, financial institution or central bank, including notes and coins in circulation.

items.instruction: Under SEBI's Buy-Back of Securities Regulations, 2018, why is a company barred from a buy-back that would remove its shares from the stock exchange?
items.response: Regulation 4 provides that a company shall not buy back its shares or other specified securities so as to delist them from the stock exchange.

items.instruction: What obligation did the RBI circular of March 6, 2024 place on card issuers with more than 10 lakh active credit cards, according to RBI's Payment Systems Report (December 2024)?
items.response: Such card issuers must give their eligible customers an option to choose from multiple card networks.

items.source: RBI - Payment and Settlement Systems Act 2007.txt
items.instruction: When may the Reserve Bank issue written directions to a payment system or system participant under section 17 of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007?
items.response: It may do so when it considers that an act, omission or course of conduct results, or is likely to result, in systemic risk being inadequately controlled.

items.source: SEBI - Master Circular for Commodity Derivatives.txt
items.instruction: Under the SEBI Master Circular for Commodity Derivatives, what must a stock exchange do before introducing trading in options on commodity indices?
items.response: A stock exchange willing to introduce trading in options on commodity indices must take prior approval of SEBI.

items.instruction: Which e-mandate categories were exempted from Additional Factor of Authentication up to ₹1 lakh, according to RBI's Payment Systems Report (December 2024), and what requirements still apply?
items.response: Subscription to mutual funds, payment of insurance premium and credit card bill payments were exempted up to ₹1 lakh. Other requirements, such as pre and post-transaction notifications and the user's opt-out facility, continue to apply.
